title: harmonize-session-ttl-and-add-lightweight-stream-adapters
author: Maya Liu
release_notes: Go SDK v1.6.0: harmonized session TTL handling with Py/TS, added lightweight streaming adapter facades, improved retry presets, and multiple test/regression fixes.
description:
Context & motivation: Our polyglot SDKs have drift in how they interpret server session TTLs and surface lease windows to callers. That leads to subtle token rotation races and duplicated retry logic in higher-level apps. This PR harmonizes the Go SDK behavior with the Python/TypeScript SDKs (lease-window semantics), introduces a small, ergonomically-friendly StreamAdapter for pull/push streaming patterns, and bumps the Go SDK minor version.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Introduce pkg/session/ttl.go which provides a SessionLease wrapper that converts server TTL (expires_at) into a client lease window and exposes deterministic RefreshNeeded() semantics; add stream/adapter.go implementing lightweight PullStream and PushStream facades with a small BufferHint API to let callers opt into zero-copy/pass-through for low-latency flows; centralize retry presets in internal/retry/presets.go to match the default profiles used in py/ts SDKs (fast-warmup, conservative, realtime); add integration tests tests/integration/session_ttl_test.go and tests/stream/adapter_e2e_test.go; update examples/streaming/credential-ttl.md with a migration note; bump go.mod to v1.6.0 and update CHANGELOG.md. The description below summarizes commits, changed files, review discussion, CI checks and merge details.

Commits (high-level): - 7c1f9a2: initial session-lease implementation and unit tests; - 2e4bff1: add StreamAdapter facades and BufferHint; - 9a712d4: centralize retry presets and wire into client.New(); - 4b8a0d6: docs and examples for streaming TTL usage; - 82d3ab7: fix linting and adjust naming per review; - d1f5a33: test flake fixes and CI config tweaks.

Files changed (high level): - pkg/session/ttl.go (new) - stream/adapter.go (new) - internal/retry/presets.go (modified) - client/client.go (wired TTL + retry presets) - tests/integration/session_ttl_test.go (new) - tests/stream/adapter_e2e_test.go (new) - examples/streaming/credential-ttl.md (doc) - go.mod, go.sum, CHANGELOG.md (version bump / release notes)

Testing & CI: CI initially failed on golangci-lint (unused var and naming complaints) and a flaky adapter e2e that relies on a mocked backend timing. I pushed two follow-ups: rename utils and add a small sleep+retry in the e2e harness. Final CI matrix: unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), linters (pass), race (pass), e2e (pass). Test coverage: added focused unit tests for TTL math and adapter buffer boundary behavior.

Review conversation (summary): - Arjun Patel (review): "Nice consolidation. One concern: RefreshNeeded() vs LeaseRefreshDue() naming — prefer something that reads as a clock/threshold. Also can we avoid exposing time.Time in the public helper?" - Author (Maya): "Addressed: renamed to LeaseRefreshDue() and switched public API to return window.Duration rather than raw time.Time; added docstring and example in examples/streaming/credential-ttl.md." - Evelyn Ross (review): "StreamAdapter is ergonomic but I worry about the BufferHint on default behavior; can we make zero-copy opt-in?" - Author (Maya): "Made BufferHint opt-in (default is safe copy). Updated README and added test for zero-copy path." - Diego Marquez (review): "CI flaked on e2e; tests look stable now. Approving pending small linter fixes." - Arjun Patel: "Approved".

Requested changes & fixes made: - Renamed API per reviewer feedback; - made zero-copy opt-in and documented tradeoffs; - folded retry presets into central internal/retry to avoid duplicating constants; - resolved golangci-lint warnings and tightened variable names; - added explicit integration test to capture token-rotation race scenario.

Compatibility & migration notes: Consumers relying on the old Session TTL helpers should migrate to the new SessionLease.{LeaseRefreshDue,RefreshNeededGrace} helpers; the migration is a small surface area change (rename + type change from time.Time to time.Duration for the refresh indicator). Examples and changelog were updated to walk through the migration. No breaking runtime behavior expected when consumers switch to new helpers; default semantics remain backward-compatible for typical usage.

Version & merge: This PR bumps the Go SDK to v1.6.0 in go.mod and CHANGELOG. After reviews and CI green, PR was merged via squash/merge on 2026-02-24.

Rollout and follow-ups: - Monitor sessions and token-rotation pager (SUP-3192) for 48h after release; - plan companion small patches in py/ts SDK repos to align naming (ENG-8479 already tracks parity housekeeping); - follow-up perf microbenchmark to ensure adapter adds negligible latency for the default (safe-copy) path.

TL;DR: Harmonizes session TTL semantics across SDKs, adds a small ergonomic StreamAdapter in Go, consolidates retry presets, bumps version to v1.6.0, and includes tests/docs to smooth migration.
